work_item.description:
Wayfinder type: grilling
Wayfinder status: open
Wayfinder Plan: pending native creation; the former map Work Item was incorrect
Wayfinder claim: unclaimed
Local path: docs/wayfinder/agent-loops/tickets/session-ownership.md

## Question

Is loop selection per Akh or per session, and which session properties remain stable across reconnects? Distinguish reconnecting a client, resuming a provider thread, and handing off to another loop. What are the client controller and observer rules?

These are decision/research questions, not implementation assignments. Keep current_phase=draft.

## Accepted selection decision

The user chose: **“One loop fixed for each Akh.”**

Loop implementation selection belongs to the Akh configuration. All sessions
of that Akh use that implementation, with separate conversation and provider
session state. A client cannot select another loop for an individual session.
Different Akhs may use different implementations.

## Remaining lifecycle question

When changing an Akh's loop, must all its sessions be closed first?
Recommendation pending user: yes, so one Akh never has sessions running different
loop implementations at the same time. Reconnect, controller and observer rules
remain covered by the loop-contract and client-contract decisions. This ticket
remains open; its selection subdecision is accepted.

## Research findings available

Codex App Server and Claude SDK expose host tool callbacks. Codex hooks expressly do not form a complete execution boundary; Claude tool exclusion, strict MCP and aliases are promising but untested together. User sign-in to unmodified Claude Code and SDK product authentication have distinct published guidance. No exclusive Akh/SSH conformance claim.

## Question

Which current official interfaces can implement AgentLoop for Cursor and OpenCode? Compare server/SDK, CLI, ACP, custom tools/MCP, subscription authentication, streamed events, approvals, cancellation, resume and reliable exclusion of native execution. Do not assume that supporting MCP gives full execution interception or that OpenCode can reuse another vendor subscription. Cite primary sources and explicitly record unknown capabilities. These are decision/research questions, not implementation assignments. Keep current_phase=draft.

Research branch: research/akh-agent-loops-cursor-opencode
Findings asset: docs/wayfinder/agent-loops/assets/cursor-opencode.md

## Research findings available

Cursor has ACP and an official SDK Bridge with local tool allowlisting and custom callbacks; restrictions must be reapplied on resume. OpenCode has server/ACP integration, but pinned source registers MCP by directory/name rather than session identity. Treat dedicated instances as a candidate until isolation tests pass. OpenCode documents ChatGPT access but rejects Claude subscription plugins. Neither adapter has proven exclusive Akh/SSH execution.

Primary sources:
- https://cursor.com/docs/sdk/bridge
- https://cursor.com/docs/sdk/typescript
- https://opencode.ai/docs/providers/
- https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/f69beceaffca94bed05a7669af93602125c37248/packages/opencode/src/acp/service.ts
